feedback_semantics.different_rating: revision replaces prior evidence in the same context; one policy update
feedback_semantics.retraction: not separately implemented; a different rating is a revision
feedback_semantics.factual_truth: not inferred from usefulness; exact quotation validation remains separate

owner_correction.effect: recorded correction row; does not grant permanent permission or imply usefulness

baselines.frozen_companion: analyse when relevance permits and no exact useful note; no feedback suppression
baselines.adaptive_companion: current policy with minimum support and source/margin
baselines.constant_analyse: analyse whenever relevance permits; no suppression

acceptance.engineering: feedback causally updates a persisted policy; future decision consults it; correction and idempotency are enforced
acceptance.research: no native or statistically significant advantage is required or claimed
